blocks.text: the: doim the bilan aytiladigan so'zlar

69-darsdagi asosiy qoida — «tinglovchi qaysi biri ekanini biladi → **the**» — ko'p turg'un holatlarni ham tushuntiradi. Quyosh bitta — **the** sun; har bir ko'chaning oxiri bitta — **the** end of the street; «xuddi shu» degani ham aniq bitta narsani ko'rsatadi — **the** same. Bunday so'zlar deyarli har doim **the** bilan keladi. Teskari guruh ham bor: watch TV, have breakfast, next week — bular odatda artiklsiz. O'zbekchada ikkala guruhda ham hech qanday belgi yo'q, shuning uchun ularni ibora sifatida eslab qolish kerak.

**same** doim **the** bilan: **the** same age (tengdosh), **the** same school (bitta maktab). «a same» yoki artiklsiz «same school» deyilmaydi. Sababi — «xuddi shu» degan so'z aniq bitta narsani ko'rsatadi. Taqqoslash uchun — **the same as**: Your phone is **the same as** mine — Telefoningiz menikiga o'xshaydi. O'zbekchada bu «bir», «bitta», «bir xil», «xuddi o'sha» bo'lib tarjima qilinadi.

items.text: Tom and I go to **the same gym**.
This phone is **the same as** yours.

blocks.text: Dunyoda bitta: the sun, the moon, the world

Hamma uchun bitta bo'lgan narsalar **the** bilan aytiladi: «qaysi quyosh?» degan savol tug'ilmaydi. O'zbekchada «Quyosh chiqdi», «Osmon tiniq» — hech qanday belgisiz; inglizchada esa artikl tushib qolmaydi: **The** sun is up. **The** sky is clear.

rows: There are no clouds in **the** sky.

blocks.text: the radio, the internet — lekin TV

Ommaviy axborot va ko'ngilochar joylar bilan: listen to **the** radio, on **the** internet, go to **the** cinema / **the** theatre. Lekin televizor bilan boshqacha: **watch TV** / **watch television**, **on TV** — artiklsiz. **the TV** faqat televizor apparatining o'zi haqida: Turn off **the** TV — Televizorni o'chir. Bu mantiqdan ko'ra odat: shunchaki ibora sifatida eslab qoling.

Ovqatlanish nomlari odatda artiklsiz: have **breakfast** / **lunch** / **dinner**, What's for **dinner**? Sifat qo'shilsa yoki aniq bir ziyofat haqida gapirilsa — artikl paydo bo'ladi: We had **a big lunch**. **The** dinner at the wedding was great. **next** / **last** / **this** + vaqt ham artiklsiz: **next** week, **last** month, **this** year. O'zbekcha «keyingi hafta» ni «the next week» deb tarjima qilmang — to'g'risi **next week**.
Joy va qism: the top, the end, the middle

Biror narsaning qismi yoki tomoni doim **the** bilan: har bir sahifaning tepasi bitta, har bir ko'chaning oxiri bitta. Bu iboralar o'zbekcha qaratqich-egalik birikmasiga juda mos keladi: «ko'chaning oxiri» — **the end of the street**, «xonaning o'rtasi» — **the middle of the room**. O'zbekchadagi egalik qo'shimchasi (`-i`, `-si`) qayerda bo'lsa, inglizchada ko'pincha **the ... of** turadi.

items.text: Sign at **the bottom of the page**.

blocks.text: E'tibor bering: yo'nalish aytganda **the** yo'q — turn **left**, turn **right**, go **straight on**. Joy aytganda esa bor — **on the left**, **on the right**. Turn left, and the bank is **on the left** — Chapga buriling, bank chap tomonda.

O'zbekchada «gitara chalmoq» va «futbol o'ynamoq» — ikki xil fe'l. Inglizchada ikkalasi ham **play**, farqni artikl ko'rsatadi: musiqa asbobi — **the** bilan (play **the** guitar, play **the** piano, play **the** dutar), sport va o'yin — artiklsiz (play football, play tennis, play chess).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «We are same age» → **We're the same age**; «Sun is very hot» → **The sun is very hot**; «I watched the TV all evening» → **I watched TV all evening**; «the next week» → **next week**; «have the breakfast» → **have breakfast**; «play the football» → **play football**; «She plays piano» → **She plays the piano** (British English); «in the end of the street» → **at the end of the street**.

Eslab qolish uchun ikki ro'yxat tuzing. **the** bilan: same, sun, moon, sky, world, sea, radio, internet, cinema, top, end, middle, left, right, guitar, piano. **the** siz: TV, breakfast, lunch, dinner, next week, last year, football, chess, turn left.

Orttirma daraja ham doim **the** bilan: **the** best, **the** biggest, **the** most expensive — 90-dars. Artiklsiz iboralar (go to work, at home, in bed) — 71-dars; umumiy ma'nodagi otlar (I like music) — 72-dars.

rows: breakfast, next week, play football, turn left, watch TV

examples.title: **the same**: the same age, the same as
examples.description: **same** doim **the** bilan: **the same** age, **the same** school. Taqqoslash — **the same as**. O'zbekchada: «bir xil», «bitta», «xuddi o'sha».

sentences.text: Aziz and I are **the same age**.
We live in **the same building**, but on different floors.
sentences.translation: Biz **bitta binoda**, lekin turli qavatlarda yashaymiz.

sentences.text: Your bag is **the same as** mine!
Every day Bekzod has **the same breakfast**: eggs, bread and tea.
sentences.translation: Bekzod har kuni **bir xil nonushta** qiladi: tuxum, non va choy.

sentences.text: Are you and Emma in **the same class**? — No, she's in 9B.
sentences.translation: Siz Emma bilan **bir sinfda**misiz? — Yo'q, u 9 «B» da.

sentences.text: My sister and I have our birthdays on **the same day** — the fifth of May.
sentences.translation: Singlim ikkalamizning tug'ilgan kunimiz **bir kunda** — beshinchi mayda.

sentences.text: Don't make **the same mistake** again!
The weather in Bukhara isn't **the same as** in Tashkent — it's hotter.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda ob-havo Toshkentdagi **bilan bir xil emas** — u yerda issiqroq.

sentences.text: James always sits in **the same seat** on the bus.
Dilnoza and her mother have got **the same eyes** and **the same smile**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bilan onasining **ko'zlari** ham, **tabassumi** ham **bir xil**.

examples.title: **the sun**, **the moon**, **the sky**, **the world**
examples.description: Hamma uchun bitta bo'lgan narsalar — **the**: the sun, the moon, the sky, the stars, the world, the earth, the sea, the ocean, the ground, the country (qishloq joy).

sentences.text: **The sun** is very strong in July, so wear a hat.
sentences.translation: Iyulda **quyosh** juda kuchli, shuning uchun shlyapa kiying.

sentences.text: Look at **the moon** — it's so big tonight!
There isn't a single cloud in **the sky** today.
sentences.translation: Bugun **osmonda** bir parcha ham bulut yo'q.

sentences.text: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in **the world**.
We spent a week by **the sea** in Turkey.
sentences.translation: Turkiyada **dengiz** bo'yida bir hafta dam oldik.

sentences.text: In winter **the ground** in Chimgan is often white with snow.
sentences.translation: Qishda Chimyonda **yer** ko'pincha qordan oppoq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: It takes **the earth** a whole year to travel round **the sun**.
sentences.translation: **Yer** **Quyosh** atrofini to'liq bir yilda aylanib chiqadi.

sentences.text: My grandparents live in **the country**, far from the noise of the city.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim shahar shovqinidan uzoqda, **qishloqda** yashaydi.

sentences.text: Uzbekistan is far from **the ocean**, so many children have never seen **the sea**.
sentences.translation: O'zbekiston **okeandan** uzoq, shuning uchun ko'p bolalar hech qachon **dengizni** ko'rmagan.

sentences.text: In the Kyzylkum desert **the stars** are very bright at night, and you can see **the Milky Way**.
sentences.translation: Qizilqum cho'lida kechasi **yulduzlar** juda yorqin, **Somon yo'lini** ham ko'rish mumkin.

examples.title: **the radio**, **the internet** — but **TV**
examples.description: listen to **the radio**, on **the internet**, go to **the cinema** / **the theatre** — **the** bilan; **watch TV**, **on TV** — artiklsiz. **the TV** — televizor apparatining o'zi.

sentences.text: I listen to **the radio** in the car every morning.
Dilnoza found a cheap flight on **the internet**.
We don't **watch TV** much — we prefer reading.
sentences.translation: Biz unchalik **televizor ko'rmaymiz** — kitob o'qishni afzal ko'ramiz.

sentences.text: Is there anything good **on TV** tonight?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **televizorda** biror yaxshi narsa bormi?

sentences.text: Can you turn off **the TV**? I'm trying to sleep.
I heard your song on **the radio** yesterday!
How often do you go to **the cinema**? — About once a month.
sentences.translation: **Kinoga** qanchalik tez-tez borasiz? — Taxminan oyiga bir marta.

sentences.text: On Saturday we're going to **the theatre** to see a comedy.
It was raining, so the children **watched television** all afternoon.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi, shuning uchun bolalar tushdan keyin bo'yi **televizor ko'rishdi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod reads the news **on the internet**, but his father still buys a newspaper.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangiliklarni **internetda** o'qiydi, otasi esa hali ham gazeta sotib oladi.

examples.title: No **the**: **breakfast**, **next week**
examples.description: Ovqatlanish nomlari (**breakfast**, **lunch**, **dinner**) va **next / last / this** + vaqt — artiklsiz. Sifat qo'shilsa — artikl: **a big lunch**.

sentences.text: What time do you usually **have breakfast**?
We're going to Samarkand **next week**.
**Lunch** is ready — come and eat!
I didn't **have dinner** last night because I wasn't hungry.
sentences.translation: Kecha **kechki ovqat yemadim**, chunki qornim och emasdi.

sentences.text: Madina started her new job **last month**.
What's for **dinner** tonight? — Plov, of course!
**Next year** Aziz wants to study in Manchester.
Sarah never has **breakfast** — she just drinks a cup of coffee.
sentences.translation: Sara hech qachon **nonushta qilmaydi** — faqat bir chashka qahva ichadi.

sentences.text: Let's meet for **lunch** on Friday at the café near the office.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni ofis yaqinidagi kafeda **tushlik** qilaylik.

sentences.text: We had **a big lunch** at Grandma's **last Sunday**, so nobody wanted **dinner**.
sentences.translation: **O'tgan yakshanba** buvimnikida **to'yib tushlik qildik**, shuning uchun hech kim **kechki ovqat** yemadi.

examples.title: **the top**, **the end**, **the middle**
examples.description: Narsaning qismi doim **the** bilan: at **the top** of, at **the bottom** of, at **the end** of, at **the beginning** of, in **the middle** of. O'zbekcha «ko'chaning oxirida» kabi.

sentences.text: Please write today's date at **the top of the page**.
The post office is at **the end of this street**.
There's a big table in **the middle of the room**.
I didn't understand **the beginning of the film**.
Our house is at **the bottom of the hill**, near the river.
Bekzod is going to Oxford at **the end of August**.
Why are you standing in **the middle of the road**? It's dangerous!
From **the top of the tower** you can see the whole of Khiva.
At **the beginning of the lesson** the teacher always checks our homework.
sentences.translation: **Dars boshida** o'qituvchi doim uy vazifamizni tekshiradi.

sentences.text: James read the whole book in one night, but he didn't like **the end**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms butun kitobni bir kechada o'qib chiqdi, lekin **oxiri** unga yoqmadi.

examples.title: Where is it? — **On the left**, **at the back**
examples.description: Joyni aytish: on **the left** / **the right**, at **the front** / **the back**, in **the corner**, on **the other side**. Yo'nalishda esa **the** yo'q: turn **right**.

sentences.text: Where's the bathroom? — It's the second door **on the left**.
Is the bank on this side of the street? — No, it's **on the other side**.
sentences.translation: Bank ko'chaning shu tomonidami? — Yo'q, **narigi tomonda**.

sentences.text: Where do you want to sit? — **At the back**, near the window.
Who's that boy **on the right** in the photo? — My cousin.
Can I sit **in the front**? I feel sick in the back.
Where's the cat? — Sleeping **in the corner**, as usual.
Is there a café near here? — Yes, **on the corner** of the next street.
sentences.translation: Yaqin atrofda kafe bormi? — Ha, keyingi ko'chaning **muyulishida**.

sentences.text: The cups are **on the top shelf**, behind the plates.
Why is the teacher standing **at the front** of the class? — She's going to read our results.
sentences.translation: Nega o'qituvchi sinfning **oldida** turibdi? — Natijalarimizni o'qib bermoqchi.

sentences.text: Turn **right** at the traffic lights, and the hotel is **on the left**.

examples.title: play **the guitar** — play **football**
examples.description: Musiqa asbobi — **the** bilan: play **the** piano, play **the** dutar. Sport va o'yin — artiklsiz: play football, play chess. O'zbekchada «chalmoq» va «o'ynamoq».

sentences.text: My brother **plays the guitar** in a band.
Aziz **plays football** every Sunday with his friends.
sentences.translation: Aziz har yakshanba do'stlari bilan **futbol o'ynaydi**.

sentences.text: Can you **play the piano**? — Only a little.
We **played chess** all evening, and I lost every game.
sentences.translation: Kechqurun bo'yi **shaxmat o'ynadik**, men har bir o'yinda yutqazdim.

sentences.text: Dilnoza's grandfather **plays the dutar** beautifully.
Emma doesn't **play tennis** any more because of her knee.
Who **plays the drums** in this band?
At school I **played basketball**, but now I prefer swimming.
sentences.translation: Maktabda **basketbol o'ynardim**, hozir esa suzishni afzal ko'raman.

sentences.text: Sarah has been learning to **play the violin** for three years.
sentences.translation: Sara uch yildan beri **skripka chalishni** o'rganyapti.

sentences.text: Bekzod **plays the piano** well, but he can't **play volleyball** at all.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **pianinoni** yaxshi **chaladi**, lekin **voleybol o'ynashni** umuman bilmaydi.

examples.title: Mixed: **the** or no **the**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: **the** sun, **the** same, **the** radio, **the** bottom, play **the** dutar — va artiklsiz: lunch, next summer, play football, last week.

sentences.text: **The sun** is shining, so let's **have lunch** in the garden.
Mum **listens to the radio** while she's cooking **dinner**.
Madina and Sarah were born in **the same year**, but in different countries.
sentences.translation: Madina bilan Sara **bir yilda**, lekin turli mamlakatlarda tug'ilgan.

sentences.text: **Next summer** we're going to **the seaside** in Turkey.
The answer is at **the bottom of the page** — don't look!
After **breakfast** the children **played football** in the yard.
Is **the moon** bigger than **the earth**? — No, it's much smaller.
I found this recipe **on the internet**, and it's **the same as** my grandmother's.
sentences.translation: Bu retseptni **internetdan** topdim, u buvimnikining **xuddi o'zi**.

sentences.text: **Last week** Aziz started to **play the dutar**, and he practises every evening.
sentences.translation: **O'tgan hafta** Aziz **dutor chalishni** boshladi, har kuni kechqurun mashq qiladi.

sentences.text: We arrived late and sat **at the back**, so we missed **the beginning of the film**.
sentences.translation: Kechikib keldik va **orqaga** o'tirdik, shuning uchun **filmning boshini** ko'rmay qoldik.
